retention_rule.positive_or_reportable_branch: retain exact branch/result identity, distribution, support, authority, ancestry and replay even when recursion stops
retention_rule.typed_nonpositive: retain exact typed result/receipt; never fabricate positive branch

current_i05_support_rule.meaning: I05 adds no additional count-based adequacy floor beyond producer typed states

state_holdings.SUPPORTED: retain; continue-eligible only under separate governed continuation predicates
state_holdings.SUPPORTED_TERMINAL: retain as learned branch; stop with exact reason
state_holdings.STABLE_MINORITY: retain; shape does not itself mandate prune or recurse
state_holdings.SPLIT_MULTIMODAL: retain competing supported configurations; recurse only under governed branch construction and continuation law
state_holdings.VALID_EMPTY: retain typed empty result and replay; no positive branch; stop
state_holdings.UNDERPOWERED_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT: retain observed/reportable distribution with limitation; block deeper split unless separately authorized
state_holdings.LOW_SUPPORT: retain producer state; no automatic recurse eligibility
state_holdings.RESIDUAL_NONE_CATEGORY_FAILURE: retain if source-semantic and observed; continuation subject to ordinary governed rules
state_holdings.MISSING_UNAVAILABLE_UNRESOLVED_NONCOMPAR: retain typed nonpositive receipt; no positive branch; stop
state_holdings.NO_MEANINGFUL_SPLIT_NO_GAIN: retain current branch; terminal stop after governed criterion
state_holdings.UNSTABLE_BRANCH: retain with uncertainty/stability qualification; report-only stop absent new authority

minimum_hq_law_gaps: exact stable-minority/split/multimodal classifier if used for continuation
exact maximum depth per controller operation
exact low-support exploratory continuation policy if desired
predictor frontier exhaustion semantics after D02 eligibility law
co-signature question frontier exhaustion semantics after D04 enumeration law
optional pure/near-pure classifier or alias to no-meaningful-split
